name: image-pixel-reveal
title: Image Pixel Reveal
description: Scroll-driven reveal that builds an image out of square pixels along a scattered edge.

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: Image to reveal. Or pass your own content as children.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Size of each pixel cell, in px.

props.name: edgeHeight
props.description: How wide the scattered pixel edge is, from 0 (clean line) to 1.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the reveal travels across the image.

props.name: parallax
props.description: Demo only: strength of the scroll parallax on each image. 0 turns it off.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Tie the reveal to scroll position. Off plays it once on enter.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the reveal in seconds when not scrubbing.

props.name: end
props.description: ScrollTrigger end position, used when scrubbing.
